Gurugram, Haryana

Professional Summary
Product designer with a strong cross-functional background in UI/UX and front-end development. Experienced in driving product design from concept to launch, collaborating with engineering and product teams to improve user engagement and conversion metrics. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 15 days.

Technical Skills
Figma, UI/UX Design, Node.js, TypeScript, Git, Jira

Work Experience
Product Designer, Paystack India (Mar 2026 - Present)
- Led redesign of merchant onboarding flow using Figma to reduce time-to-complete by 28% and increase activation rate; collaborated with engineers to implement designs.
- Drove UI/UX Design for dashboard analytics widgets, creating reusable components that improved development velocity and consistency across products.
- Partnered with product managers and used Jira to manage sprints, tracking design tasks and handoffs to engineering.

Product Designer, Ola (Jun 2025 - Feb 2026)
- Designed a new in-app payments experience in Figma, improving checkout conversion by 12% through simplified flows and microcopy updates.
- Conducted rapid prototyping and usability testing to iterate UI/UX Design for driver settlements, reducing support tickets related to payouts.
- Coordinated with engineering teams via Git and Jira to ensure pixel-accurate implementation of designs.

UI/UX Designer, Infosys (Apr 2024 - May 2025)
- Delivered end-to-end design for an enterprise reporting portal using Figma, improving task completion rates for users handling complex reports.
- Implemented UI/UX Design standards and component libraries to accelerate project delivery and ensure visual consistency across modules.
- Documented design specifications and worked with developers through Git-based workflows and Jira for issue tracking.

Full Stack Developer, Vertex Analytics (Mar 2021 - Mar 2024)
- Built data ingestion and visualization features using Node.js and TypeScript, resulting in a 35% faster data processing pipeline.
- Developed RESTful APIs and front-end integrations that enabled new analytical dashboards, improving client report delivery times.
- Maintained codebase and collaborated via Git and Jira, introducing type-safe patterns in TypeScript to reduce runtime errors.

Education
B.Sc Computer Science, St. Xavier's College
